[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of famous abstract sculptors for inspiration, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Constantin Brancusi (1876-1957) - Known for "Bird in Space" and "The Column of the Infinite."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Henry Moore (1898-1986) - Known for "Reclining Figure" and "Mother and Child."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Barbara Hepworth (1903-1975) - Known for "Monolith-Empyrean" and "Sphere with Inner Form."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Isamu Noguchi (1904-1988) - Known for "Black Sun" and "Red Cube."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Alberto Giacometti (1901-1966) - Known for "Walking Man" series.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Richard Serra (1939-present) - Known for "Tilted Arc" and "Clara-Clara."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Anish Kapoor (1954-present) - Known for "Cloud Gate" (The Bean) in Chicago.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Rachel Whiteread (1963-present) - Known for "House" and "Untitled (One Hundred Spaces)."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Eva Hesse (1936-1970) - Known for "Contingent" and "Accession."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Claes Oldenburg (1929-2022) and Coosje van Bruggen (1932-2009) - Known for "Spoonbridge and Cherry" and "Typewriter Eraser."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for working with wire mesh, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choosing the right mesh (aluminum or copper, 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch gauge).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cutting and shaping with wire cutters or bolt cutters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bending and forming using a wire former or heat gun.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Welding or binding with a wire welder
